description: Get an enriched company profile by ticker symbol. Returns CIK, exchange, sector, industry, market cap, employee count, description, and other fundamental data. This is a lightweight lookup -- use this when you only need basic company info rather than the full bundle. Always includes halted/haltCode/haltedAt trading-halt status (false/null when trading normally); a halted-but-listed ticker reports delisted:false. `sharesOutstanding` is DATED: `sharesOutstandingAsOf` + `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` ("stated" = the issuer's statement date; "checked" = when it was last confirmed against a vendor; "none" = date not recorded) and a vendor-free `sharesOutstandingSource`. Quote the date with the count; null is NOT MEASURED, never zero.
name: get_company_profile
title: Get Company Profile
